newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Japanese consortium to sign Kuwait offset deal.
newsitem.headline: Japanese consortium to sign Kuwait offset deal.

text.p: A Japanese consortium will soon sign an accord pledging to invest 19.56 million dinars ($65 million) in Kuwait to offset a contract to build water desalination units, officials said on Tuesday.
An official at Kuwait's offset programme said Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Mitsui and Sasakura Engineering Co would soon conclude the re-investment accord.
Kuwait's arms suppliers and large commercial contractors are obliged to re-invest 30 percent of a deal's worth in a project of their choice provided it has official approval.
In April the Japanese consortium won a 65.2 million dinar order to build the units, becoming the first non-military project in Kuwait to carry an offset pledge.

"According to offset programme rules, a supplier has about one year to present (offset) proposals for approval to start implementation," said Mazen Madou, monetary affairs controller at the Finance Ministry.
